evidence: M-O s.v. nail: clip one’s nails

phrases.latin: Dā mihi manum; unguēs tibi resecābō.
phrases.english: Give me your hand; I’ll cut your nails.

phrases.latin: quīn ipsī prīdem tōnsor unguīs dēmpserat: collēgit, omnia abstulit praesegmina.
phrases.english: why, the other day the barber had cut his nails; he gathered up all the parings and took them away with him.

phrases.latin: et prāvē sectum stomachēris ob unguem
phrases.english: and you fume over a badly cut nail
quietly cleaning his own nails with a penknife

sources: Lewis & Short: praeseco
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. nail: clip one’s nails.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 58.
